verdict.rationale: Phoenix offers prompt versioning ('Version, store, and deploy prompts', 'you can version prompts, test prompt variants... before rolling them out') and dataset/experiment comparisons across app versions, which cover review and some rollback-like workflow for prompts. However, Phoenix is an observability/eval platform, not an automation/workflow builder, so there's no evidence of versioning or rolling back full agentic automations/pipelines themselves — only prompts and datasets. Missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for automations/workflows (not just prompts), audit trail of automation changes, and evidence of reverting a live automation to a prior version.
